name: successor-retag
purpose: Recheck the exact v2 Linux wheel with the previously locked auditwheel 6.8.2 / wheel 0.48.0 toolset, then retag only WHEEL and RECORD to the actual manylinux ABI verdict
reuse: Existing CPython 3.12.13 and immutable source/native wheel. Reuse an existing matching tool target if available; otherwise install the four hash-locked pure Python tools from r2-prep-310/retag-tools.txt into one plain target on D:. No virtual environment, native compiler, dependency source clone or driver build.
writes: All extraction, tool installation, temporary files, logs and cache use the owned D: scratch. Original C: sources and guest interpreter remain read-only. The D: backing volume and guest filesystem must be writable and keep the original reserve.
retention: Keep exact tool source/license archive once by hash, lock, actual child exits/waits, ABI report, source/native/member joins and retagged wheel outside scratch. Only WHEEL and RECORD may differ. Apply unchanged strict cleanup and rehash retained files before another run.
scope: Packaging prerequisite only. No installed-check, candidate, mandatory-profile, physical GPU or release admission transfers from the input wheel.
